Run native functional recovery scenarios with semantic scientific metrics

etr_run_functional_recovery_scenarios.Rd

Run declared functional simulation scenarios and score estimator recovery, without exposing the simulator's latent truth to the estimator. Recoveries can be returned as named finite scalar metrics or source-aligned semantic recovery assessments with component/source labels and metric definitions.

Usage

etr_run_functional_recovery_scenarios(
  scenarios, mean, eigenfunctions, estimator, recovery,
  failure_action = "raise", source_draws_by_replicate = NULL,
  observation_times_by_replicate = NULL, random_engine = "base_R",
  python_boundary_mode = FALSE
)

Arguments

source_draws_by_replicate

Ordered records of retained source draws per replicate.

observation_times_by_replicate

Ordered fixed irregular schedules per replicate.

random_engine

"base_R" preserves the existing native draws. "numpy" uses the source-seeded PCG64 mode of etr_simulate_functional_process() for each scenario seed. Fixed source draws require "base_R".

scenarios

Nonempty list of declared native etr_functional_simulation_scenario records.

mean

Callable generating the functional population mean.

eigenfunctions

List of generating functional component callables.

estimator

Function of (observations, scenario). Exact generating truth is never passed to this callback.

recovery

Function of (fit, truth, scenario). Must return either a named finite numeric metric vector or an etr_functional_recovery_assessment containing nonempty values of semantically defined metrics and optional named provenance. Metric component indices are zero-based in source records and shown one-based in output keys/frames.

failure_action

Either "raise" to propagate a failure or "record" to preserve explicit simulation, fit, or recovery errors without redraw or fabricated metric output.

python_boundary_mode

If TRUE, follow declared published-source boundary semantics; FALSE retains native validation defaults.

Value

An etr_functional_recovery_result with one ordered record per attempted replicate, metric_definitions describing the source metric names, and provenance distinguishing the R random engine from frozen Python. Structured successes retain metric_values and assessment_provenance; failures retain their status, exception category and message.

Details

Native Student-t and Gaussian functional simulations with dense or irregular schedules, source power-phase variation, correlated measurement noise and MCAR/block dropout can be driven by the declared scenario fields. Scientific truth remains isolated from the estimator callback and available only to the recovery callback.

Structured assessments are validated for finite values, nonempty semantic metric definitions, unique component/source tuples, unique flattened metric keys and stable definitions across replicates. A conflicting definition for the same metric name is an error even when failure_action="record".

The result uses native R records. Seed replay is qualified for the documented simulation subdomain. Full Python type, callback, and exception contracts and independent scientific certification remain open.
